properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 resolved in pnpm-lock.yaml, a transitive dependency of the direct root dependency elliptic 6.6.1. Ships SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations into the build tree; no first-party call site in root code. Same package as scout-1 object LIB-e966a74e (library view of hash.js).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 one-time authenticator shipped as @stablelib/poly1305@1.0.1 and inside the AEAD @stablelib/chacha20poly1305@1.0.1 — transitive dependencies of the fuels-ts SDK this Fuel wallet is built on. Symmetric MAC: quantum impact limited to Grover's square-root speedup.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Single-round MD5 EVP_BytesToKey KDF shipped inside the browserified node:crypto polyfill stack that this web/CRX bundle carries; no application code calls it — presence, not use, is what the inventory records here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: package.json:135 is a live pnpm override — "secp256k1": "@noble/secp256k1" — a supply-chain governance artifact replacing the native secp256k1 binding with pure-JS @noble/secp256k1 tree-wide; the two pnpm-lock sites (line 29 importers entry, line 28400 override record) show the override taking effect. secp256k1 signing is the wallet's core operation (Fuel chain transaction signing), so the algorithm genuinely ships. Changeable here.
